semantic_order: approach → CPU commit → active window → contact/outcome → recovery

reproduction.wiring: src/apps/browser/main.ts per-slot CPU composition root with CpuObservation.cpuDefensiveTackle

cross_runtime_note: Ticks are the Chromium run's own. The pinned Node trajectory in docs/evidence/CPU-DEFENSIVE-TACKLE/trajectory.json records the same attempt structure; per-tick hashes are not comparable across runtimes (known pinned-runtime gap).

frames.label: cpu-tack-before
frames.description: Approach: the CPU presser is closing on the opposing carrier and has committed to nothing yet

frames.label: cpu-tack-commit
frames.description: CPU commit: the team-decision profile authorised this standing tackle (prepare; reaction latency 3 ticks)

frames.label: cpu-tack-active
frames.description: Active window opens at commit + 2: finite reach 1.6 m contact becomes eligible in the committed cone

frames.label: cpu-tack-outcome
frames.description: Outcome: active-window tackle contact resolved (velocity-only deflection / separation impulse) and play continues past the beaten carrier

frames.label: cpu-tack-recovery
frames.description: Recovery: the committed body is still capped and locked out, so the challenge cannot be instantly re-tried
